'''Little Gut''' was the trained [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] of [[Ronum Minkus]], a participant in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] Little Gut was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]" and was defeated in the eighth round of the Arena fights.

==Behind the scenes==
Little Gut appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the eighth boss of the "Eternal Championship."
